mostWorthwhile.text: Lifting and holding the glass brought the systems together in a familiar action. It showed that muscles continue working even when the arm is still.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the gut to the heart and lungs was useful, but the explanation that cells release energy from nutrients remained broad; a little more about how oxygen helps would make the link clearer.

surprise.text: I was surprised that holding the glass still requires continuing muscle pulls and energy.

arbitrary.text: No action lacked a clear purpose, although each decision offered only one combination, so I was following the available route rather than figuring out compatibility.

continue.text: I would continue if another chapter explored a similarly familiar action. The final connection made me curious, though the single-option decisions offered little choice.
